capabilities_done: SidechainDynamics (src/sidechain.rs): reuses the Dynamics gain computer (compressor/expander/gate, Giannoulis soft knee, peak or RMS detector, attack/release, hold, range, makeup, link) and adds lookahead (main delayed round(lookahead_ms*rate/1000) samples = reported latency, detector on the undelayed key) and KeySource::External{channels} (input = main channels then key channels, output = main channels; linked = loudest key, unlinked = key i drives main i); Internal key with lookahead 0 is bit-identical to Dynamics; allocation only at construction

FeedbackDelay (src/delay.rs): D = round(time_ms*rate/1000) samples (>= 1, 0..5000 ms), line = x + feedback*f(tap), out = (1-mix) x + mix tap; impulse echoes exact at m*D with feedback^(m-1) (48k/44.1k/96k tested); optional one-pole loop damping 20..rate/2 Hz (unity DC; echo 2 = fb(1-k)k^j tested); stereo ping-pong; feedback -0.99..0.99; delay line <= MAX_DELAY_LINE_SAMPLES (8Mi f64) checked before allocation; latency 0; tail_frames() bound tested; f64 loop state with 1e-30 flush
